body.message:
Dear Mr. Zaid,

We completely understand your frustration and sincerely regret the inconvenience this situation has caused.

However, we would like to clarify that from our side, we provided all the necessary check-in information, including the designated parking slot details, prior to your arrival. After receiving your concern, we also contacted the City Walk management on your behalf and made every effort to have the parking fines waived.

Unfortunately, the management has confirmed that the fines were issued because the vehicle was parked in a parking space other than the designated one provided, and therefore they are unable to cancel or waive the fines. As this decision rests solely with the building management, it is beyond our control.

We appreciate your understanding and thank you for your patience in this matter.
